nodes.text:
India confirmed its first two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) on Monday after an outbreak in China. The virus, which causes respiratory infections, raised concerns across the region. Amid rising fears, the stock market dropped by nearly 3% today.

#HMPV #stockmarketcrash
